title: Zed 1.0 editor released
description: Zed 1.0, the high-performance code editor, has been released. Currently top story on Hacker News with 1901 points and 603 comments.
author: Zed team

title: Granite 4.1: IBM's 8B Model Matching 32B MoE
description: IBM released Granite 4.1, an 8B model that matches the performance of 32B mixture-of-experts models.
author: firethering.com

title: Mozilla's opposition to Chrome's Prompt API
description: Mozilla has publicly opposed Chrome's Prompt API proposal. Discussion on HN with 142 points and 57 comments.
author: Mozilla

title: The Zig project's rationale for their anti-AI contribution policy
description: Simon Willison wrote about Zig programming language's anti-AI contribution policy. Currently 345 points on HN with 167 comments.
author: Simon Willison

title: Cursor Camp - AI coding playground
description: Cursor Camp, a tool for experimenting with AI coding, has 991 points on Hacker News with 160 comments.
author: neal.fun

title: Alignment whack-a-mole: Finetuning activates recall of copyrighted books in LLMs
description: Research showing that finetuning LLMs can activate recall of copyrighted books. Discussion on HN with 145 points.
author: cauchy221

title: Legal AI startup Legora hits $5.6B valuation
description: Legal AI startup Legora has reached a $5.6 billion valuation, intensifying its competition with Harvey in the legal AI space.
author: Anna Heim

title: OpenAI restricts access to Cyber model after Anthropic criticism
description: After criticizing Anthropic for limiting access to Mythos, OpenAI has also restricted access to its Cyber model, showing similar concerns about advanced AI capabilities.
author: Julie Bort

title: OpenAI announces new security for ChatGPT with Yubico partnership
description: OpenAI announced advanced security features for ChatGPT accounts, including a partnership with Yubico for hardware security keys.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Elon Musk testifies that xAI trained Grok on OpenAI models
description: In court testimony, Elon Musk admitted that xAI trained Grok on OpenAI models, raising questions about training data practices.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Google's Gemini AI assistant coming to millions of vehicles
description: Google announced that its Gemini AI assistant will be integrated into millions of vehicles, expanding AI presence in automotive sector.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Stripe introduces Link digital wallet for AI agents
description: Stripe launched Link, a digital wallet that autonomous AI agents can use, enabling AI systems to handle payments directly.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Meta's business AI facilitates 10M conversations per week
description: Meta announced that its business AI tools now facilitate 10 million conversations weekly, showing strong adoption of AI in business messaging.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Anthropic could raise $50B at $900B valuation
description: Sources indicate Anthropic is in discussions to raise a new $50 billion funding round at a $900 billion valuation, marking one of the largest AI funding rounds.
author: Marina Temkin, Jagmeet Singh

title: Microsoft has over 20M paid Copilot users with high usage
description: Microsoft reported having over 20 million paid Copilot users, with data showing they are actively using the AI coding assistant, countering concerns about low engagement.
author: Julie Bort

title: Google Cloud surpasses $20B but growth capacity-constrained
description: Google Cloud exceeded $20 billion in revenue but reported that growth was constrained by capacity, likely due to AI infrastructure demands.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Is AI video a prequel? Runway CEO sees world models as next
description: Runway's CEO believes AI video generation is just a stepping stone to more advanced world models, indicating the next phase of AI evolution.
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Rebecca Bellan

title: Google Photos uses AI to recreate iconic 'Clueless' closet
description: Google Photos demonstrated AI capabilities by virtually recreating the famous closet from the movie 'Clueless', showcasing AI's role in photo organization and visualization.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Firestorm Labs raises $82M for drone factories in shipping containers
description: Firestorm Labs raised $82 million to build drone factories inside shipping containers, bringing manufacturing closer to deployment locations.
author: Kate Park

title: Shapes app brings humans and AI into same group chats
description: Meet Shapes, a new app that enables humans and AI agents to participate together in group chats, representing a new model for human-AI collaboration.
author: Aisha Malik

title: DeepSeek V4—almost on the frontier, a fraction of the price
description: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek released V4 preview models (DeepSeek-V4-Pro and DeepSeek-V4-Flash), positioning them as nearly frontier-level at a significantly lower price point than competitors.
author: Simon Willison

title: Honker: Postgres NOTIFY/LISTEN semantics for SQLite
description: A Rust SQLite extension implementing transactional outbox pattern with Kafka-style durable streams. Enables real-time queue processing with 1ms polling on .db-wal files.
author: Simon Willison

title: Claude Code quality postmortem: Agentic systems have complex bugs
description: Anthropic released a postmortem on Claude Code quality issues. Three separate bugs in the Claude Code harness caused material problems, including a bug that made Claude seem forgetful by clearing thinking every turn instead of just once.
author: Simon Willison

title: Bluesky's For You feed: 419GB SQLite on a gaming PC
description: The For You feed serving 72,000 Bluesky users runs on a single Go process with SQLite on a gaming PC (16 cores, 96GB RAM, 4TB NVMe). Stores 90 days of data. Total cost: $30/month. Architecture by spacecowboy.
author: Simon Willison
